name: Competitor website tracker: weekly AI briefing of design and messaging changes with MiroMiro

parameters.content:
## Competitor website tracker
Every Monday, MiroMiro reads your competitors' homepages: brand colors, fonts, hero headline, calls to action and the list of sections. The workflow compares them with last week and AI emails you a short briefing of what changed and what it might mean.

Catches things like: a new hero message, a changed call to action ("Start free" -> "Book a demo"), a new pricing or testimonials section, a rebrand.

Snapshots are kept in the workflow's own memory, so there is nothing else to set up. The first run saves a baseline. About 20 MiroMiro credits per competitor per week.

**Setup (3 minutes)**
1. Get a free MiroMiro API key (300 credits a month, no card): https://miromiro.app/api/onboarding, then add it on any MiroMiro node.
2. Put your competitors in **Settings**, one URL per line.
3. Add your AI model credential on **Chat model** (Anthropic here; OpenAI or Gemini work too).
4. Connect Gmail on **Email the briefing** and set your address (or swap it for Slack).
5. Activate the workflow. Snapshots are only remembered on scheduled runs, not on manual test runs.

parameters.text:
=You track competitors' websites for a marketing team. Below is this week's check of each competitor's homepage, measured by MiroMiro: brand colors, fonts, hero headline, calls to action and sections, compared with last week.

{{ $json.reportsText }}

Write a short competitor briefing in Markdown:
- Start with exactly this count: {{ $json.changed }} of {{ $json.total }} competitors changed something this week. (A first check or a failed check is not a change.)
- Then one "## <competitor domain>" block per competitor. If it changed: list each change in plain words, then one line on what it might signal (new positioning, a rebrand, a pricing push, a new feature...). If "firstCheck" is true: say a baseline was saved and summarize its current positioning in one sentence from the headline and calls to action. If nothing changed: "No changes since <lastChecked>."
- End with "## Worth a look" - at most 2 suggestions for our own site, only if a change justifies it.
Only use the facts above. Under 300 words.
